purpose: Real-time communication and fleet management platform for truck drivers and fleet administrators.

stack.themeMode: Light/dark via Tailwind CSS variables (bg-background, text-foreground, etc.)

routeGroups.(auth): Unauthenticated pages — login, register. No Navbar/BottomNav. Centered card layout.
routeGroups.(protected): Driver-facing authenticated pages. Wrapped by Navbar + BottomNav + CallStateWrapper + SosAlertListener.
routeGroups.(admin): Admin-facing authenticated pages. Wrapped by AdminSidebar + AdminHeader. Completely separate layout from driver.
routeGroups.api: Next.js Route Handlers only — no UI rendered here.

globalLayout.description: Root layout. Wraps entire app in <Providers> (SessionProvider + SocketProvider) and renders Sonner <Toaster richColors position='top-right'>. Font: Inter.

rootPage.description: Server component. Reads session via auth(). If authenticated → redirect('/dashboard'). If not → redirect('/login'). Acts as a smart entry point.

realtime.mechanism: Single Ably.Realtime instance created per authenticated session (keyed on userId). Authenticates via authUrl: '/api/auth/ably-token'.

channels.user:{userId}: Private per-user channel. Receives: nearby_driver_update, voice_message_received, text_message_received, friend_request_received, friend_request_accepted, call_incoming, call_declined, call_missed, call_ended, error.
channels.fleet:locations: Shared admin channel. Receives: driver_location_updated (FleetDriverUpdate payload).

api.on(event, handler): Subscribe to an Ably event. Returns unsubscribe function. Uses a listener registry (Map<EventName, Set<handler>>) so multiple components can subscribe to the same event without creating duplicate Ably subscriptions.
api.emit(event, ...args): Intentional no-op. All client→server data goes through REST API routes, not WebSockets.
api.onConnect(cb): Register a callback that fires immediately if already connected, or queues for next connect event. Used by dashboard to re-broadcast GPS on reconnect.
api.isConnected: Boolean state. True when Ably connection state is 'connected'.

realtime.connectionIndicator: LiveConnectionBadge component in the Navbar shows green Wifi icon + 'Live' text when connected, amber pulsing WifiOff + 'Reconnecting…' otherwise.

login.ui: Centered Card (max-w-sm). Truck icon header. Email + Password inputs. Client-side Zod validation (UserLoginSchema) before calling signIn('credentials'). Error shown inline in destructive/10 bg box. On success → router.push('/') which triggers middleware redirect matrix. Footer note: 'Admins are redirected to the fleet dashboard automatically.'

register.ui: Centered Card (max-w-sm). Role selector at top: two clickable button cards side by side — 'Truck Driver' (Truck icon) and 'Fleet Admin' (LayoutDashboard icon). Selected card gets border-primary + bg-primary/10. Full Name, Email, Password fields. When 'Fleet Admin' is selected, an additional password-type 'Admin Invite Code' field appears. On submit: Zod validation, then POST /api/auth/register. 409 conflict / 403 forbidden errors shown as inline server error. On success → redirect /login?registered=1.

wrappers: CallStateWrapper — provides call state context, watches for incoming call_incoming Ably events, shows incoming call UI overlay
SosAlertListener — globally listens to stress_signal_alert, fires toast.error with 🚨 message for any driver page
BottomNav — fixed bottom bar, mobile only
driverLayout.mainContainer: flex-1 container mx-auto px-4 py-6 max-w-5xl pb-20 md:pb-6 (pb-20 leaves room for BottomNav on mobile)

navbar.description: Sticky top-0 z-50. Blurred glass background: bg-background/95 backdrop-blur supports-[backdrop-filter]:bg-background/60.
navbar.left: Truck icon + 'TruckConnect' brand text (text hidden on mobile via hidden sm:inline). Links to /dashboard.
navbar.center: Nav links — hidden md:hidden, shown md:flex. Links: Dashboard, Map, Messages, Friends, Stress. Active link gets bg-accent text-accent-foreground. Inactive: text-muted-foreground.
navbar.right: LiveConnectionBadge + Avatar (circle, 32x32, shows profile image if loaded else initials, hover ring-2 ring-primary, links to /profile) + LogOut ghost button (calls signOut with callbackUrl:/login). Avatar fetched from /api/profile on mount.

bottomNav.description: Fixed bottom-0, md:hidden. 5-column grid, 64px tall. Glass background + border-t.
bottomNav.activeStyle: text-primary (non-emergency) or text-destructive (emergency). Active icon background: rounded-xl pill, bg-primary/10 or bg-destructive/10. Active icon stroke-[2.5] (bolder).
bottomNav.emergencyDot: Pulsing 8x8 red dot (bg-destructive animate-pulse) in the top-right of the SOS icon.

dashboard.description: Driver home page. Real-time nearby driver list + GPS broadcast.

sections.name: Header
sections.content: Title 'Dashboard' + subtitle. Right side: LiveConnectionBadge (Wifi/WifiOff icon + 'Live'/'Reconnecting…' colored text) + 'Refresh Location' outline button (Navigation icon).

sections.name: My Location Card
sections.content: shadcn Card. Shows lat/lng in font-mono when acquired. 'Broadcasting' badge (green dot + 'Broadcasting' text in secondary badge) when active. Loader spinner while acquiring. Error text (text-destructive) on geolocation failure.

sections.name: Nearby Drivers
sections.content: Section header with 'Nearby Drivers' + animated Badge (count). Empty state: motion.div fade-in Card with 'No drivers within 50 km' message. Populated: 2-column grid (sm:grid-cols-2) using AnimatePresence with popLayout mode. Each driver is a motion.div (layout, initial scale+opacity, exit). Contains DriverCard.

dashboard.gps: navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition → POST /api/drivers/location every 20 seconds via setInterval. Also re-fires on Ably reconnect (onConnect callback).

map.description: Full-screen Leaflet map showing nearby drivers. Dynamically imported (ssr:false) via Next.js dynamic(). Supports ?focus=userId query param to auto-select a driver.
map.layout: Edge-to-edge map with floating overlays. Map takes full remaining viewport height.
features: Clicking a driver pin → shows info panel below map (or side panel on desktop) with name, coords, distance, Message/Call buttons
?focus=userId auto-focuses that driver's marker on map if within range, else toast.info 'Friend not visible'
Loading spinner while DriverMap chunk loads

messages.description: Two-panel messaging page. Left: FriendsSidebar. Right: ChatPanel. Fully split-panel on desktop, slide animation on mobile.
messages.desktopLayout: Hidden md:hidden wrapper shows both panels side-by-side. Sidebar: fixed 340px wide. Chat panel: flex-1.
messages.mobileLayout: Slide transition via AnimatePresence. Sidebar slides in from left (x: -100% → 0), chat slides in from right (x: 100% → 0). Spring animation (stiffness:260, damping:20). Only one panel visible at a time.
messages.outerContainer: relative -mx-4 -mt-6 -mb-20 md:m-0 — breaks out of the layout padding on mobile to fill full height between Navbar and BottomNav. h-[calc(100dvh-7.5rem)] on mobile, md:h-[calc(100vh-80px)] on desktop.
messages.queryParam: ?from=userId — auto-opens that conversation via autoOpenId prop passed to FriendsSidebar
messages.wrappedIn: Suspense (required by useSearchParams in App Router)
realtime: text_message_received → skip if sender is currently open → toast.info 💬 + 'Open chat' → /messages?from={senderId}
voice_message_received → skip if sender is currently open → toast.info 🎙️ + 'Open chat' → /messages?from={senderId}

friends.description: Friend management: list, send request, receive/accept/decline requests, view friend location, call/message.

sections.name: Send Friend Request
sections.content: Input with label 'Friend Tag'. Format validated client-side: /^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+#[0-9]{4}$/. POST /api/friends/request. UserPlus icon button.

sections.name: Incoming Requests
sections.content: AnimatePresence list. Each request shows sender name + tag + relative time. Green accept button (Check icon, POST /api/friends/request/{id}/accept) + red decline button (X icon, DELETE). On accept: appended to friends list, request removed.

sections.name: Friends List
sections.content: AnimatePresence list. Each friend card: name, tag, 3 action buttons — Message (→ /messages?to={id}), Map (→ /map?focus={id}), Call (CallButton component). Location toggle button (MapPin icon): fetches /api/friends/{id}/location, shows lat/lng inline or 'hasn't shared location' toast.

realtime: friend_request_received → toast.info + prepend to requests list
friend_request_accepted → toast.success + prepend to friends list

stress.description: Emergency SOS page. Large animated button to send stress signal + list of active + live-incoming signals.

sections.name: Emergency Button Card
sections.content: Card with CardHeader. Center: breathing glow ring (motion.div: scale 1→1.25→1, opacity 0.6→0→0.6, 2.4s infinite) + round 112x112 destructive button. Button state: idle (AlertTriangle icon + 'SOS' text), loading (Loader2 spinner), sent (CheckCircle2 icon). whileTap scale:0.94 + whileHover scale:1.04. Requires confirmation dialog before sending.

sections.name: Confirmation Dialog
sections.content: AnimatePresence modal card slides down. Two buttons: Confirm (destructive) + Cancel.

sections.name: Active Signals List
sections.content: Fetched from /api/stress-signals/active. StressSignalBadge components per signal.

sections.name: Live Alerts
sections.content: Real-time signals received via Ably. Prepended to top, capped at 10. Each triggers toast.error.

stress.flow: Button click → setConfirmOpen(true) → confirmation → navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition → POST /api/stress-signals + emit('send_stress_signal') → justSent state (CheckCircle2 shows for 4s) → fetchActive()

profile.description: Driver profile page with avatar management.

sections.name: Avatar Card
sections.content: 96x96 circle. Shows current profileImageUrl via next/image (fill + object-cover) or initials fallback. Hidden file input (accepts image/jpeg,png,webp,gif). 'Change Photo' button triggers file picker. Selecting a file shows blob: URL preview immediately (local preview ring: border-primary + ring-4 ring-primary/30). 'Upload' button: POST /api/profile/upload-avatar multipart (field: avatar). On success updates profile state.

sections.name: Info Card
sections.content: Name, email, tag (displayed as badge), account creation date. Static display, no inline editing.

profile.animation: Page entrance: motion.div opacity:0,y:12 → opacity:1,y:0 over 0.3s

calls.description: LiveKit call room for drivers. Reads call token from sessionStorage key 'trucknet_active_call' (JSON: roomName, type, token, liveKitUrl, role). Renders @livekit/components-react <LiveKitRoom> with <VideoConference> or voice-only preset. On disconnect → router.push('/dashboard').

adminDashboard.description: Admin home. StatsBar + FleetMap + SosPanel side-by-side.
adminDashboard.layout: flex-col. Top: StatsBar (flex-wrap row). Bottom: flex-row with flex-1 map + w-80 SosPanel sidebar.
adminDashboard.dataFetch: fetchStats (every 30s auto-refresh), fetchLiveDrivers (once on mount), fetchSosAlerts (once on mount). No polling for map — real-time via Ably fleet:locations.
interactions: SosPanel onViewOnMap(driverId) → sets focusDriverId → FleetMap.MapFocuser flies to driver
SosPanel onResolve(alertId) → PATCH /api/admin/sos/{id}/resolve → removes from list
SosPanel onNewAlert → prepend to alerts list + refresh stats

adminDrivers.controls: Search input + status filter (all/online/offline). Resetting to page 1 on filter change.
adminDrivers.table: DriverTable component. Shows 20 drivers per page. Pagination with prev/next.

adminSos.description: Full SOS alert log with filter tabs.
adminSos.filters: All / Active / Resolved — pill buttons. Active filter gets bg-red-600 text-white.
adminSos.actions: Inline resolve button per card → PATCH → optimistic UI sets status to 'resolved', decrements activeCount.

adminMessages.layout: Rounded-xl bordered container. Left: AdminConversationList (w-72, border-r). Right: AdminConversationThread (flex-1). Empty right state: centered 'Select a conversation' text.
adminMessages.deepLink: app/(admin)/admin/messages/[driverId]/page.tsx — pre-selects the thread by matching driverId from URL param against conversations list.

adminCalls.description: Call history log table. Filterable by call type (voice/video) and status (ongoing/completed/missed/declined). 25 entries per page.

adminCallRoom.description: LiveKit call room for admins. Same pattern as driver call room but on disconnect → router.push('/admin').

props.activeFriendId: string | null — currently selected friend, used for active styling and unread suppression
props.autoOpenId: string | null | undefined — if set, auto-clicks the matching contact once loaded (used by ?from= query param)

FriendsSidebar.dataFetch: Parallel: GET /api/friends/list + GET /api/text-messages/conversations. Merges non-friend conversation partners (e.g. admins) from conversations into the contacts list. For friends without conversation history, fetches GET /api/text-messages?friendId={id} for preview. Sorts all contacts by lastMessageAt descending.
FriendsSidebar.realtime: on('text_message_received'): if sender exists → update lastMessage/unreadCount. If sender unknown → append new entry to sidebar (handles admin→driver first message).
FriendsSidebar.autoOpen: useEffect watching [autoOpenId, loading, friends]. Fires once (autoOpenFired ref) when loading=false and friends contains the target id.
FriendsSidebar.unreadReset: useEffect watching [activeFriendId] — sets unreadCount:0 for the active friend.

ui.header: h2 'Messages' + search Input with Search icon (pl-9). Rounded-xl input.
ui.emptyState: MessageSquare icon (opacity-30) + 'No results' or 'No friends yet'.
ui.list: motion.ul (opacity:0→1 fade-in over 0.18s). Each li: motion.li with simultaneous opacity:0,y:4 → opacity:1,y:0 over 0.15s. No stagger (prevents invisible-but-tappable items on mobile).
ui.item: min-h-[48px], flex, gap-3, rounded-xl px-3 py-3. Active: bg-primary/10 + left border indicator (motion.span layoutId='active-indicator', absolute left-0 w-1 rounded-full bg-primary). Avatar 40x40 with green online dot (bottom-right, ring-2 ring-background). Name + relative time on first row. Last message preview on second row. Unread Badge (rounded-full, min-w-[20px], h-5, '99+' cap).

ChatPanel.dataFetch: On mount/friend change: parallel GET /api/text-messages?friendId={id} + GET /api/voice-messages. Auto-marks all unread messages from this friend as read (PATCH /api/text-messages/{id}/read for each).
ChatPanel.messageTypes: Combines text messages (TextMessageData) and voice messages (VoiceMessageData) into a single sorted CombinedMessage[] array by createdAt.
ChatPanel.autoScroll: useEffect on [textMessages.length, voiceMessages.length]. Finds Radix ScrollArea viewport ([data-radix-scroll-area-viewport]) and sets scrollTop = scrollHeight. Fallback to scrollIntoView.
realtime: text_message_received → if senderId matches → append + PATCH read
voice_message_received → if senderId matches → append + toast.info
ChatPanel.header: Friend avatar + name + tag + CallButton (voice + video).
ChatPanel.messageList: ScrollArea flex-1. Each item: MessageBubble (text) or VoiceMessageBubble (audio). Grouped by sender (isSelf = senderId === currentUserId).
ChatPanel.input: MessageInput component at bottom: text textarea + RecordButton for voice. Submit on Enter (not Shift+Enter). Voice: records via useVoiceRecorder hook, uploads to /api/upload/audio, then POST /api/voice-messages.

MessageBubble.description: Single text message. isSelf → right-aligned, primary color background. Other → left-aligned, muted background. Shows sender name if not self, timestamp bottom-right, status indicator (read/delivered tick).

VoiceMessageBubble.description: Audio player bubble. Play/pause button + waveform visualization + duration. Styled same alignment as MessageBubble.

DriverCard.description: shadcn Card showing a nearby driver. Name as CardTitle + distance badge (MapPin icon, format: 'm' if <1km else 'x.x km'). Lat/lng in small mono text. Message + Alert buttons (flex-1 each, outline and destructive variants).

AdminSidebar.description: Fixed w-56 left sidebar for admin layout. Dark: bg-gray-900, border border-gray-800.
AdminSidebar.branding: TruckIcon (text-blue-400) + 'TruckNet' bold white + 'Admin' pill (text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-widest).
AdminSidebar.nav: 5 links: Overview, Drivers, SOS Alerts, Messages, Call History. Active: bg-blue-600/20 text-blue-400. Inactive: text-gray-400 hover:bg-gray-800 hover:text-white.
AdminSidebar.sosBadge: Pulsing red rounded badge on 'SOS Alerts' link showing count. Incremented in real-time via stress_signal_alert Ably event. Initial count from /api/admin/stats.

AdminHeader.description: Top bar of admin layout. Shows logged-in admin name + avatar + sign out button.

StatsBar.description: Horizontal flex-wrap row of stat cards. 6 cards: Total Drivers (blue), Online Now (green), Active SOS (red), Ongoing Calls (purple), Calls Today (yellow), Messages Today (cyan). Each: icon in colored rounded-lg bg + bold white value + small gray label. While stats===null: skeleton (h-4 w-20 bg-gray-700 animate-pulse).

FleetMap.description: Leaflet map for admin fleet overview. SSR-safe (client component with 'use client').

pins.withAvatar: 34x34 divIcon: circular avatar image with colored border.

FleetMap.popup: On pin click: avatar + name + 'online'/'recently active' + time ago. Voice button (blue), Video button (purple), Message button (gray). Calling: POST /api/calls/initiate → sessionStorage 'trucknet_active_call' → router.push('/admin/calls/{roomName}'). Message: router.push('/admin/messages/{driverId}').
FleetMap.realtime: on('driver_location_updated'): update existing driver coords or append new driver.
FleetMap.focuser: MapFocuser child component: useMap() hook, flies to focusDriverId's coords (flyTo zoom:14, animate:true duration:1).

SosPanel.description: Right sidebar panel on admin home. Lists active SOS alerts.
SosPanel.header: AlertTriangle icon + 'Active SOS Alerts' + red count badge.
SosPanel.realtime: on('stress_signal_alert'): builds SosAdminEntry and calls onNewAlert prop.
SosPanel.cards: SosAlertCard per alert: sender name/tag/avatar, lat/lng, time ago, 'View on Map' button (calls onViewOnMap → triggers FleetMap focus), 'Resolve' button (PATCH + callback to remove).

DriverTable.description: Paginated admin driver table with search and status filter.
DriverTable.columns: Avatar, Name, Tag, Email, Status (Online/Offline badge), Last Seen, Actions.
DriverTable.actions: Voice call, Video call (both → /api/calls/initiate → sessionStorage → /admin/calls/{roomName}), Message (→ /admin/messages/{id}).
DriverTable.filters: Text search input + All/Online/Offline pill buttons. Status pills: active = bg-blue-600/20 text-blue-400, inactive = bg-gray-800 text-gray-400.
DriverTable.pagination: Previous/Next buttons + 'X–Y of Z' count text.

AdminConversationList.description: Left panel conversation list for /admin/messages. Fetches GET /api/text-messages/conversations.
AdminConversationList.items: Avatar, partner name, last message truncated, relative time, unread count badge. Selected: highlighted with bg-blue-600/10 border-l-2 border-blue-500.
AdminConversationList.realtime: Updates last message preview and unread count on text_message_received.

AdminConversationThread.description: Right panel message thread for /admin/messages. Loads GET /api/text-messages?friendId={driverId}.
AdminConversationThread.messages: AdminMessageBubble per message. Self (admin) right-aligned. Other (driver) left-aligned.
AdminConversationThread.input: Textarea + Send button. Keyboard: Cmd/Ctrl+Enter to send. POST /api/text-messages.
AdminConversationThread.realtime: on('text_message_received'): filter by driverId, append to thread.

AdminConversationList_deepLink.description: Deep-link route. On load: fetches conversations list, finds matching driverId, pre-selects the thread. Falls back to stub from /api/admin/drivers/{driverId} if no conversation yet.

SosAlertListener.description: Invisible component mounted in protected layout. Subscribes to stress_signal_alert, fires global toast.error with 🚨.

CallButton.description: Reusable call initiation button. Calls POST /api/calls/initiate with calleeId + type. On success: sessionStorage 'trucknet_active_call' + router.push to call room. Shows loading state while awaiting.

CallHistoryTable.description: Admin call log table. Columns: Caller, Callee, Type (Voice/Video badge), Status (colored badge: ongoing/completed/missed/declined), Duration, Date. Filter buttons for type and status. Pagination.

designSystem.colorScheme: CSS variable-based Tailwind theme. bg-background, text-foreground, border-border, text-muted-foreground, bg-accent, text-primary, text-destructive, etc.
designSystem.adminColors: Hardcoded dark palette: bg-gray-950 body, bg-gray-900 sidebar/cards, border-gray-800 borders, text-white headings, text-gray-400 body text. Blue accent: text-blue-400, bg-blue-600/20.
designSystem.borderRadius: rounded-xl used pervasively for cards, inputs, buttons, list items. rounded-full for avatars, badges, pings.
designSystem.spacing: Consistent space-y-6 section spacing. gap-3/gap-4 for grids. px-4 py-3 for card padding.
designSystem.shadows: shadow-lg on call button, shadow-sm on cards. Map pins use box-shadow rgba.

animations.listItems: opacity:0,y:4 → opacity:1,y:0 over 0.15s (all simultaneously, no stagger on mobile)

accessibilityNotes: FriendsSidebar uses role='navigation', role='listbox', aria-label, role='option', aria-selected, tabIndex=0, onKeyDown Enter/Space
Emergency button has aria-label='Send emergency stress signal' and focus-visible:ring-4
Buttons have sr-only text where icon-only (LogOut button in Navbar)
Unread count badges have aria-label='{n} unread messages'
mobileSpecificBehaviors: Messages page: sidebar and chat panel are never shown simultaneously — slide transition only
BottomNav replaces Navbar links on mobile (md:hidden)
Messages page container breaks out of layout padding (-mx-4 -mt-6 -mb-20) to fill edge-to-edge
Bottom nav has 80px height allowance (pb-20 in layout)
FriendsSidebar list animates all items together (no stagger) to prevent tapping invisible items during enter animation
Map loaded with dynamic() + ssr:false, shows Loader2 spinner while chunk loads

sessionStorageKeys.trucknet_active_call: JSON: { roomName, type ('voice'|'video'), token (LiveKit JWT), liveKitUrl, role ('caller'|'callee') }. Written before navigating to call room. Read by call room page to initialize LiveKitRoom.

toastPatterns.success: toast.success — friend accepted, location updated, signal sent, avatar uploaded
toastPatterns.error: toast.error — 🚨 stress alerts, call failures, upload failures, geolocation errors
toastPatterns.info: toast.info — 💬 text message preview, 🎙️ voice message, friend request, friend not on map
toastPatterns.duration: 6000–12000ms for notification toasts. action button navigates to relevant page.

errorHandlingPatterns: Field-level Zod errors shown inline below each input as
Server errors shown at top of form in bg-destructive/10 rounded box
API failures generally surface via toast.error
Loading states: Loader2 animate-spin centered or skeleton placeholders in tables/cards
